name: @zebbern/hacktricks-mcp
description: MCP server giving AI agents fast full-text search and section-level retrieval over the HackTricks security wiki and its Cloud book (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, CI/CD), and a check of cloud permissions against the book's rated lists and escalation catalog. Ships with a pre-built index of both books, synced with upstream every 3 days and refreshed in the background.

scripts.version: node scripts/version-sync.mjs && node scripts/sync-skills.mjs && node scripts/sync-agents.mjs && git add server.json .claude-plugin/plugin.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json .codex-plugin/plugin.json .zcode-plugin/plugin.json kimi-plugin/skills kimi-plugin/agents .codex/agents
